documents.title: Acme Corp - Enterprise Proposal v3
documents.summary: 3-year Enterprise Software License proposal for Acme Corp manufacturing operations. Total investment $450,000 ($150K/year) with 10% volume discount applied. Includes implementation services ($45K), training ($15K), and 24/7 premium support ($30K/year). Payment terms: Net 30. SLA: 99.9% uptime guarantee. Implementation timeline: 8-10 weeks from contract signing.

Phased rollout agreed: pilot with engineering team first.
